purpose: Rank a small number of potential craft interventions by expected literary benefit under preservation risk, without producing revision text.
rules: High impact cannot override a critical preservation risk.
Low-confidence opportunities cannot outrank high-confidence purpose-critical opportunities solely because they are stylistically attractive.
Opportunity count should be bounded; the engine should prefer the highest-value limiting factor.
NO_ACTION is valid when expected value is insufficient or risks are unresolved.
Opportunity records diagnose targets; STEP-E does not rewrite passages.
